description: The fused BlockSparseMLP path allocates intermediate buffers with the caller dtype but passes them to activation kernels that reinterpret bytes as FP16.
trigger: One flattened token and fully EXL3 experts select the fused path, with interm_dtype unset under the ordinary float32 default or explicitly a supported non-half output dtype such as float32.
expected_behavior: Resolve or validate intermediate dtype so activation kernels receive FP16 buffers, or use activation implementations matching the actual dtype.
actual_behavior: With interm_dtype=None and default float32, torch.empty produces float32 buffers and multi-GEMM writes float32 outputs; silu_mul/gelu_mul read those bytes as half without dtype checks. Source reading predicts wrong results. Passing torch.half avoids this mismatch.

introductions.rationale: 139 introduces the fused path and allocates intermediates using interm_dtype, whose default is None.

observations.description: Reviewer traced buffer allocation, native output dtype and activation half reinterpretation.

verification.description: Compared fused allocation and native multi-GEMM output acceptance with the unchecked FP16 activation kernels.
verification.limits: No GPU execution or numerical comparison. Model-specific construction not established; condition is caller-dependent. Other non-half types may fail earlier rather than silently produce wrong values.

affected_revisions.limits: Reviewer source observation at139 only; no continuous affected range.
